name_zh: 马利/牙买加/雷鬼/拉斯塔/非洲/癌症/鲍勃/救赎/一爱/雷鬼
description_zh: 鲍勃·马利 (1945-1981) 牙买加歌手/音乐家，通过雷鬼音乐和拉斯塔信仰传播和平信息，被誉为 "雷鬼之王", 对拉美文化和音乐产生深远影响，被誉为 "音乐之神", 马利精神成为全球和平和爱的象征。
description_en: Bob Marley (1945-1981) Jamaican singer/musician, through reggae music and Rastafari faith spread peace message, known as "King of Reggae", had profound impact on Latin American culture and music, known as "God of Music", Marley spirit became global symbol of peace and love.
reason_zh: 马利代表拉美文化如何通过音乐传播和平信息，如何通过雷鬼音乐和拉斯塔信仰建立全球和平运动，以及如何成为拉美文化和音乐的象征，体现了拉美文化的进步性。
reason_en: Marley represents how Latin American culture spreads peace message through music, establishes global peace movement through reggae music and Rastafari faith, and becomes symbol of Latin American culture and music, embodies progressiveness of Latin American culture.
